title: नेपाली समसामयिक चित्रकलाः राजनैतिक गतिशीलताको प्रतिविम्व (Contemporary Nepali Painting: A Reflection of Political Dynamics)
nepali: नेपाली समसामयिक चित्रकलामा राजनैतिक गतिशीलताले निम्त्याएको परिदृश्य प्रतिविम्वित चित्रहरुमा एत्रतत्र सर्वत्र पाउन सकिन्छ । नेपालको संस्कृतिक, बहुभाषिक विविधताले भरिएका देशमा अनेकन राजनैतिक उथलपुथल भएको देखिन्छ्र । पृथ्वीनारायण शाहले एकीकरण अभियान संगै थालेको आधुनिक नेपाल माथि टेक्दै एंग्लो–नेपाल युद्वको परिणाम स्वरूप सृजित सुगौली सन्धिको ढोकाबाट प्रवेश पाएको सभ्य, व्यवस्थित र परिस्कृत पश्चिमा शैलीले परम्परा विपरित आधुनिकताको परिदृश्यलाई सीमांकन गरी कछुवाको गतिमा अघि बढेको पाउन सकिन्छ । राजनैतिक विग्रहमा तिनका ध्यानाकर्षण र हटेका ठाँउहरुमा बनेका प्रतिबिम्बात्मक धार्मिक चित्रहरु, राणाकालिन ब्यक्तिचित्रहरु, वि. सं. २००७ को प्रजातन्त्र वाहाली पछिका यथार्थ र अमुर्त चित्रहरु, र बि.सं. २०४७ सालको प्रजातान्त्रिक पुनर्वाहाली पश्चात जातीय, लैंगिक, क्षेत्रीय चित्रहरुमा ठिमाह, द्विविधा, र बहुलताको पहिचानलाई आत्मसाथ गर्दै अघि बढेको प्रष्ट देख्न सकिन्छ । (The scenario caused by political dynamics in Nepali contemporary painting can be found everywhere in the reflected paintings. american_english: The landscape brought about by political dynamics in Nepali contemporary painting can be found everywhere across the reflected paintings. In Nepal, a country filled with cultural and multilingual diversity, numerous political upheavals are seen to have taken place. Stepping upon the modern Nepal initiated by Prithvi Narayan Shah alongside the unification campaign, the civilized, orderly, and refined Western style that gained entrance through the door of the Sugauli Treaty created as a consequence of the Anglo-Nepal War can be found to have demarcated the landscape of modernity contrary to tradition and advanced at a turtle's pace. In political conflicts, their focus and in displaced spaces, reflective religious paintings, Rana-era portraits, realistic and abstract paintings following the advent of democracy in 2007 B.S., and following the restoration of democracy in 2047 B.S., in ethnic, gender, and regional paintings, it can be clearly seen to have moved forward embracing the identities of hybridity, ambivalence, and plurality.

informal_english: The landscape brought about by political dynamics in Nepali contemporary painting can be found everywhere across the reflected paintings. In Nepal, a country packed with cultural and multilingual diversity, you can see there have been all sorts of political upheavals. Standing on the modern Nepal started by Prithvi Narayan Shah alongside the unification campaign, the civilized, orderly and refined Western style that came in through the door of the Sugauli Treaty after the Anglo-Nepal War marked out the landscape of modernity against tradition and crept ahead at a turtle's pace. And in political conflicts, drawn to displaced spaces, through reflective religious paintings, Rana-era portraits, realistic and abstract paintings after democracy came in 2007 B.S., and after democracy was restored in 2047 B.S., across ethnic, gender and regional paintings, you can plainly see it moving forward embracing the identities of hybridity, ambivalence and plurality.
